findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: In beat 5 the question's term 3^{n+1} lights with its split, but in beats 7–9 only the split on line 2 lights. A student cannot see which question term (3^{n-2}, 3^{n-1}, 3^{n+2}) each split comes from.
findings.fix: At the start of beats 7, 8 and 9, also light the matching piece of the question line (b, c, d) in the same tone as its split, as beat 5 does for a.

findings.problem: The ↑ on the '✗ Common mistake' note points up at the 'Add power' note, not at the split line, so it reads as a comment on the law.
findings.fix: Drop the arrow on the common-mistake note, or set its near to the 3^n × 3^1 term so it clearly explains the split.
